primary.name: Judgment
primary.shortDesc: Critical Damage: +6%
details: Skill can be found in <tt src={/class-icons/link-skills/link-manager.png} tip={Link Manager (Beginner Skill)}>

primary.name: Psychic Attack
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 5, Max Enemies Hit: 3, Damage: 100%, Number of Attacks: 2
details: Can also be assigned a Key Slot

primary.name: Return
primary.shortDesc: Returns to Kinesis's Hideout.\nCooldown: 600 sec
details: To obtain this skill, complete the Lv. 28 quest "Heading Home"

primary.name: ESP
primary.shortDesc: Critical Rate: 10%, Avoidability: 12%, Speed: +10
details: Upon completing the tutorial, 6 SP are given that can all be allocated to this skill

primary.name: Hero's Echo
primary.shortDesc: Increases Attack Power & Magic ATT by 4% for 2400 sec\nCooldown: 300 sec
details: To obtain this skill, complete the quest <link href={https://maplestorywiki.net/w/Quests/112/King:_Master_of_Space_and_Time} title={"King: Master of Space and Time"}>
Affects all nearby players

primary.name: Psychic Force
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 10, Max Enemies Hit: 5, Damage: 110%, Number of Attacks: 3
primary.desc: Cast a psychic attack forward that pushes enemies back
details: Pressing the Down Arrow Key and Skill Key together performs an attack that knocks enemies downwards<bp_Can be resisted by some enemies_>

primary.name: ESP Booster
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 20, Duration: 180 sec, Attack Speed: +2

primary.name: Kinetic Step
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 5. Allows you to jump a greater distance.
details: Can be assigned a Key Slot or activated by pressing jump twice
While in the air, you can press the Up Key and Jump Key together to perform a vertical jump<bp_Horizontal jump can be used once after jumping_>
Horizontal jump can be used twice in a row

primary.name: Defend
primary.shortDesc: Max HP: +20%, Max MP: +30%, DEF: +500, Damage Taken: -75%

primary.name: Mental Fortitude
primary.shortDesc: Speed: +20, Max Speed: +20, Jump: +20, Critical Rate: +15%

primary.name: Psychic Rise
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 20, Max Enemies Hit: 6, Damage: 220%, Number of Attacks: 3
primary.desc: Cast a psychic attack forward that lifts enemies

primary.name: Ultimate: Pressure
primary.shortDesc:
When using a direct attack skill (excluding common skills), chance to activate a micro black hole at the location of enemies within a set area: 100%
Micro Black Hole: Max Enemies Hit: 8, Damage: 210%, Number of Attacks: 4, Gravitational Waves: 6, Max Attacks on a Single Enemy: 4
Cooldown: 6 sec
Breakthrough Cooldown: 2 sec
primary.desc: Periodically, successful direct attack skills trigger a damaging black hole at the location of enemies
details: Activation location prioritizes bosses with the highest Max HP
While <tt src={/class-icons/other/kinesis/breakthrough.png} tip={Breakthrough (4th Job)}> is active, this skill's cooldown is reduced
Unaffected by cooldown resets

primary.name: Psychic Sprint
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 100. Allows you to charge a set distance.

primary.name: ESP Mastery
primary.shortDesc: Psy-limiter Mastery: +50%, INT: +40, Magic ATT: +30

primary.name: Pure Power
primary.shortDesc: Attack Speed: +1, Damage: +10%, Critical Rate: +15%

primary.name: Mental Strength
primary.shortDesc: Final Damage: +10%, Knockback Resistance: +50%

primary.name: Psychic Fall
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 30, Max Enemies Hit: 6, Damage: 300%, Number of Attacks: 4
primary.desc: Cast a psychic attack forward that lifts enemies and slams them

primary.name: Ultimate: Opening
primary.shortDesc:
MP Cost: 200, Max Enemies Hit: 1, Damage: 260%, Number of Attacks: 6, Debuff Duration: 7 sec
Gravitational fields pull objects towards debuffed enemies, attacking up to 8 enemies for 260% damage 6 times. Maximum gravitational fields: 2.
When the debuff duration ends, an explosion hits debuffed enemies for 390% damage 12 times.
When using on an enemy with an active debuff from Opening, the previous debuff ends immediately, triggering an explosion and performing additional attacks equal to the remaining number of gravitational field attacks.
Cooldown: 30 sec.
Breakthrough Cooldown: 10 sec
primary.desc: When used, debuff a single enemy that causes debris to continously strike the enemy and nearby enemies
details: While active, pressing the Skill Key again ends the debuff early and detonates an explosion that deals damage based on the remaining number of attacks left
While <tt src={/class-icons/other/kinesis/breakthrough.png} tip={Breakthrough (4th Job)}> is active, this skill's cooldown is reduced
Unaffected by Damage Reflect (except first attack) and cooldown resets

primary.name: Kinetic Jaunt
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 100, Temporarily gain the power to fly.\nCooldown: 2 sec.
primary.desc: While held, hover and move in the air using the Arrow Keys
details: When no Arrow Keys are pressed, hover in place
Skill can be used in all directions except downwards (Down Arrow Key)
Unaffected by cooldown resets

primary.name: Warp
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 55. Uses 1 Condensed Psychokinesis.\nTeleport horizontally a distance of 570, or vertically a distance of 320\n1 Condensed Psychokinesis is recharged everry 10 sec, and you can hold up to 3 at a time.
primary.desc: Teleport in a given direction using Arrow Keys to a nearby platform
details: Skill uses a special resource called [Condensed Psychokinesis] which are prepared every 10 seconds (Max. 3)

primary.name: Kinetic Combo
primary.shortDesc: Upon landing a direct attack skill (excluding common skills), 50% chance to create 3 energy bombs. For Ultimate skills, 40% chance.\nEnergy Bomb: Damage: 110%, Number of Attacks: 3
primary.desc: Successful attacks have a chance to create an additional attack that seek and attack a nearby enemy
details: Successful attacks from Ultimate skills have a lower chance to activate
Prioritizes bosses with the highest Max HP
Unaffected by Damage Reflect

primary.name: Psychic Reinforcement
primary.shortDesc: Magic ATT: +20, Damage: +16%, Final Damage: +15%

primary.name: Transcendence
primary.shortDesc: Magic ATT: +30, Critical Damage: +10%

primary.name: Mitigation
primary.shortDesc: Status Resistance: +20, Elemental Resistance: +30%, Knockback Resistance: +50%, Max HP: +30%\nAvoidability: +20%

primary.name: Psychic Smash
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 40, Max Enemies Hit: 8, Damage: 451%, Number of Attacks: 5\nFor 60 sec, Hit Enemies Defense: -15%, Speed: -30%
primary.desc: Smash psychic objects forward that damages and debuffs enemies
details: [Debuff]: Reduces %DEF and %Speed<bp_Reduction to %DEF can be considered as %Ignore DEF_>

primary.name: Ultimate: Gambit
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 200, Damage: 147%, Number of Attacks: 9, Max Enemies Hit: 12, Number of Hits: 9\nCooldown: 30 sec.\nCooldown: 10 sec
primary.desc: Release a train that smashes down on an area
details: While <tt src={/class-icons/other/kinesis/breakthrough.png} tip={Breakthrough (4th Job)}> is active, this skill's cooldown is reduced
Unaffected by Damage Reflect and cooldown resets

primary.name: Ultimate: Check
primary.shortDesc:
MP Cost: 200, Damage: 687%, Number of Attacks: 7, Max Enemies Hit: 8, Energy Orbs: 5
Against a single enemy, energy orbs are combined to attack a maximum of 3 times.
Cooldown: 30 sec.
Cooldown: 10 sec
primary.desc: Throw psychic orbs forward in a cone
details: Up to 3 orbs can hit a single enemy
While <tt src={/class-icons/other/kinesis/breakthrough.png} tip={Breakthrough (4th Job)}> is active, this skill's cooldown is reduced
Unaffected by Damage Reflect and cooldown resets

primary.name: Breakthrough
primary.shortDesc: Immediately resets cooldown of Ultimate skills on use.\nUltimate Skill Final Damage: +12% for 30 sec, Breakthrough cooldowns used for Ultimate skills.\nCooldown: 120 sec.
primary.desc: When used, resets cooldown of Ultimate skills and grants a buff for Ultimate skills that increases %Final Damage and reduces cooldowns
details: Unaffected by cooldown resets and %Buff Duration

primary.name: President's Orders
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 70, Goddess of the Otherworld appears\n[Passive Effect: All stats with a direct AP investment increase by 15%]
details: Skill is a passive, the active effect does nothing except displays an animation

primary.name: Clear Mind
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 30, Cooldown: 180 sec.\n[Passive Effect - Abnormal Status Resistance: +21]
primary.desc: Removes certain abnormal status effects and become immune to Abnormal Status for a few seconds
details: [Passive]: Permanently increases Abnormal Status Resistance

Unaffected by <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/paladin/combat-orders.png} tip={Temporarily increases all of your skill levels. Only 4th Job Skills can be increased beyond master level while other skills can only be increased to master level. Exceptions: Some special skills, beginner skills, Combat Orders, hyper skills, 5th job skills, and 6th job skills cannot be increased.}/> Combat Orders

primary.shortDesc: Weapon Mastery: +73%, Magic ATT: +73, Final Damage: +10%
details: Increases %Weapon Mastery provided
Now increases %Final Damage and grants flat Magic Attack

primary.name: Awakening
primary.shortDesc: Magic ATT: +9%, Final Damage: +26%, Critical Damage: +15%

primary.name: Concentration
primary.shortDesc: Buff Duration: +20%, Final Damage: +18%\nMP Absorb Chance: 20%, Amount Absorbed: 5% of Max MP, Amount Absorbed: 3% of the boss's Max MP

fifthMain.desc: Release a psychic cube that damages enemies and explodes
details: Unaffected by Damage Reflect

fifthMain.name: Ultimate: Checkmate
fifthMain.shortDesc:
MP Cost: 500
Max Enemies Hit: 12, Damage: 437%, Number of Attacks: 7, Chess Pieces: 3
The chess piece ricochets off enemies up to 5 times
If Breakthrough is active when the attack hits, it resets the cooldown of Ultimate skills.
Cooldown: 30 sec
Breakthrough Cooldown: 5 sec
fifthMain.desc: Send several chess pieces bouncing around the screen that damages in a large area
details: While <tt src={/class-icons/other/kinesis/breakthrough.png} tip={Breakthrough (4th Job)}> is active, this skill's cooldown is reduced<bp_Additionally, if the skill successfully hits enemies, the cooldown of other Ultimate skills are reset_>
Prioritizes bosses with the highest Max HP
Unaffected by Damage Reflect and cooldown resets

fifthMain.name: Psychic Castle
fifthMain.shortDesc:
MP Cost: 1000
Create a giant game of chess - Max Enemies Designated as King: 15, Duration: 20 sec
While active, a pincer occasionally triggers for 5 sec
When the attack hits, it increases the pincer trigger duration by 5 sec every 1 sec. When the pincer trigger duration ends, pincers cannot trigger even if the buff is active.
Upon landing active Ultimate skills or From Another Realm 75 times, the game ends and triggers Endgame, where the king is dealt an additional attack.
Any remaining pincer triggers will be dealt as additional Endgame hits.
Pincer - Max Enemies Hit: 15, Damage: 1540%, Number of Attacks: 7, Max Triggers: 28
Endgame - King Enemy Damage: 1800%, Number of Attacks: 11, Ending: 5
Cooldown: 120 sec
fifthMain.desc: When used, enemies are designated as [Kings] that upon dealing a set amount of successful hits from Ultimate skills or <tt src={/class-icons/other/kinesis/from-another-realm.png} tip={From Another Realm (6th Job)}> will trigger a final attack [Endgame] on marked enemies
details: While active, successful hits triggers an additional attack [Pincers]<bp_Successful hits increases the duration of [Pincers]_>
Right-clicking the skill toggles ON/OFF the background visual effect
Prioritizes bosses with the highest Max HP
Unaffected by Damage Reflect
